raw_text: Violence erupting in multiple Pakistan cities after Imran Khan arrest. Military installations targeted in Lahore, Rawalpindi, Peshawar. GHQ Lahore gate set on fire. Jinnah House in Lahore under attack by mob. Army convoys moving through Islamabad. Internet going down across country. Worst political crisis since 1971.
